title: Courses page
content:
Chemistry courses from N5 to Advanced Higher

Three levels, one teacher, and never more than eight pupils in a class. Taught by Lynsey Robinson — over 20 years in Scottish classrooms and a current SQA marker.

National 5 Chemistry

Where Chemistry stops being general science and starts demanding precision. Foundations, calculations and the language the SQA wants back.

National 5 Chemistry tuition →

Higher Chemistry

The jump everyone warns you about, and the grade universities look at. Applying understanding to problems pupils have never seen before.

Higher Chemistry tuition →

Advanced Higher Chemistry

Closer to first-year university than to Higher. Mechanisms, thermodynamics, instrumental analysis and the project.

Advanced Higher Chemistry tuition →

Included in every course

  • Revision materials for every topic on the course
  • Quizzes to check understanding as you go
  • Assessments under exam conditions
  • A weekly assessment, with feedback sent to parents

All of it is included in the price — there is nothing extra to buy.

Prices vary by course and group — enquire for current rates.

Not sure which level?

If your child is between levels, or taking Higher without having sat N5 Chemistry, send an enquiry and Lynsey will tell you honestly what she would recommend.
